content.text: Excitement will be heightened as Rory McIlroy, a Masters champion who has won the Grand Slam, represents Northern Ireland. Additionally, this is the location where Shane Lowry, an Irishman, achieved a remarkable Open win in 2019.
The defending champion at The Open is American golfer Xander Schauffle who won at Royal Troon in Scotland in 2024..
The Open Championship will take place at Royal Portrush from July 13 to July 20, 2025.
